# Claudealyzer 0.1.1

A small update focused on navigation.

## What's new

- **Project tree in the sidebar.** Sessions moved out of the History view into the sidebar, grouped under
  their project. Expand a project to load its sessions; changing the sort or filters reloads every open
  project at once. History now has more room for the conversation itself.

## Under the hood

- Spartan Native updated to 0.2.1 and pulled from the published packages instead of local copies.
- Smaller macOS DMG background and file icon.
- Website screenshots converted to WebP and remade with the new sidebar. The tooling that makes them now lives
  in `scripts/screenshots/`, so they can be regenerated after UI changes.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `claudealyzer-macos-arm64.zip` |
| macOS, Intel | `claudealyzer-macos-amd64.zip` |
| Windows x64 | `claudealyzer-windows-amd64.exe` |
| Linux x64 | `claudealyzer-linux-amd64` |

Install notes are unchanged from
[0.1.0](https://github.com/molnarroland/Claudealyzer/releases/tag/v0.1.0#before-you-run-it).
